description: The typed, columnar schema describing how a table's rows are loaded into a zetta DDF DataFrame (ENT-33). Each column maps a numeric JSON field, or a declared ISO-8601 timestamp, to a typed device column.

dtype.description: The numeric element type the column holds (the zetta::compute::DataType set).

field.description: The JSON key in each row's doc to read; defaults to `name` when omitted.

name.description: The column's name in the frame (and the row field to read, unless overridden by `field`).

timestamp.description: When true on a float column, accept ISO-8601 strings or finite epoch numbers and normalize them to epoch seconds.

title: DataFrameSchema
